program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_ld": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "L_cs":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 6e-6),
    "I2":      (5e-6, 2.5e-6, 7e-6),
    "Wn_inv":  (0.6, 0.42, 1.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]
    gmid_cs = 10.0

    # bias diode and mirrors (same L, same gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], It, vds=0.4)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode M3, M4) and the replica CS device M5
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], It / 2, vds=0.85)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # preamp: vinp up -> o1 up
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # gain stage: o1 up -> o2 down
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # output inverter: o2 down -> vout up
    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]
    Wp = 2.5 * Wn
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # ---- predictions ----
    go1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / go1
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / go1
    t1 = math.log(2) * tau1
    Cinv = (Wn + Wp) * 0.15 * 1e-14 + (Wn + Wp) * 0.6e-15
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + Cinv + 0.5e-15
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / I2
    Ion = 250e-6 * Wn
    t3 = cl * (vdd / 2) / Ion
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    offset = 0.0
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "A1": A1, "tau1": tau1}

events.topology: NMOS diff-pair preamp with low-gain PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS gain stage with NMOS mirror sink, then CMOS inverter
